'''Yasil Senerio''' was a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who managed a farm on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Freliq]], during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was an adamant supporter of the idea that the [[lepusa]] were an intelligent [[Species/Legends|species]], especially after seeing his [[Jullisa Senerio|daughter]] be rescued by a lepusa's handiwork.<ref name="Creatures of the Galaxy" />
